name: Knoxville City Championship
epitaph: Its own record opens with the belt already around Sinister's waist, and both of its two surviving defenses end the same way: Sinister's arm raised. The first came in a three-way against Mark Thomas and Chi Chi LeVaughn, settled by the Chi-Town Massacre; the second, weeks later, against the Amazing Wigga.

name: Volunteer Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Stevie Scott held it through both of the belt's surviving defenses, first against Matt Donovan, then against Brian Storm three weeks on, the second win coming only after Michelle Bailey's interference turned the finish.

name: Smokey Mountain Tag Team Championship
epitaph: McCloud Valentine and Chi Chi LeVaughn held it into a 29 May 2001 defense against Southern Uprising, last-minute replacement challengers standing in for an injured team, who left with the titles.
